The most likely fault is the gate of Mp3, which is tied to `sp0` (the source node of Mp0, a near-VDD bias node) instead of `n2`, the output of the preceding stage. In a ring oscillator each stage's inputs should come from the previous stage. Every other stage's PMOS gate follows this pattern, so Mp3 is the outlier. With its gate stuck near the supply, stage 3 cannot switch, which breaks the ring. That matches the collapsed swing (1.85 mV against a 1.03 V target) and the failed frequency and tuning-ratio specs. Mp3 also has the largest swing sensitivity. Mp0 and Mp4 are the next candidates because they sit in the same stage-0 and stage-4 PMOS paths.
